info.title: UIAutomationMcp CLI
info.description: Windows UI Automation CLI for coding agents and scripting. Inspect desktop elements, query trees, read text and selection, and drive control patterns from the terminal with JSON output. Windows only.

commands.name: focused
commands.description:
handle --handle <hwnd>
point --x <x> --y <y>
find-name --name <text>
find-class --class <class>
find-automation-id --automation-id <id>
inspect [locator flags]
find [locator flags] [--max-results <n>]
children [locator flags] [--view raw|control|content] [--max-results <n>]
descendants [locator flags] [--view raw|control|content] [--max-results <n>]
navigate [locator flags] --direction <parent|first-child|last-child|next-sibling|previous-sibling|normalize> [--view raw|control|content]
text [locator flags]
selection [locator flags]
table [locator flags] [--max-rows <n>] [--max-columns <n>]
reads a Grid/Table control as a cell matrix (defaults: 50 rows, 25 columns)
action <focus|invoke|set-value|expand|collapse|toggle|select|add-to-selection|remove-from-selection|maximize|minimize|restore|close|move|resize|scroll|scroll-percent|set-range-value|set-view|dock|realize|default-action> [values] [locator flags]
set-view <view-id|view-name>   switches a MultipleView control (see multipleViewPattern.supportedViews)
dock <top|left|bottom|right|fill|none>
realize                        realizes a virtualized item so it can be read or acted on
default-action                 runs the MSAA default action (LegacyIAccessible) for controls with no modern actionable pattern
wait-event --event-kind <focus|automation|property|structure|text-edit> [--timeout-ms <ms>] [--event-id <id>] [--property-id <id>] [locator flags]
text-edit                      observes auto-correct, IME composition, and auto-complete changes (TextEdit pattern)
drag and drop are automation events: --event-kind automation --event-id 20026 (drag start), 20027 (cancel),
20028 (complete), 20029 (drag enter), 20030 (drag leave), 20031 (dropped)

options.name: --no-virtualized
options.description: do not ask ItemContainer providers for items missing from the live tree
